quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the Philadelphia 76ers' championship potential with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I don't think I'm so convinced that this is just a championship team off the rip.
quotes.quote: I don't think I'm so convinced that this is just a championship team off the rip. I think they become dangerous, but they're still going to have to compete with the youth of this league, and that's going to compete against LeBron's age, Embiid's health. They're going to lean a lot on Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on LeBron James's speed and age
quotes.excerpt: If they had LeBron five years ago where he could run, I just don't think he can sustain.
quotes.quote: If they had LeBron five years ago where he could run, I just don't think he can sustain. Even though he can still get up and down, it's just the speed that V.J. Edgecombe and Maxi might want to play at. LeBron can't play at that speed and sustain it for a full, no, he's going to have to play it in bursts and do this here and there, but he can't do that to his body, not this year.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on LeBron James playing in the 2028 Olympics
quotes.excerpt: I don't think we need to see him on the Olympic team having to carry a load.
quotes.quote: I don't think we need to see him on the Olympic team having to carry a load, but I would love for him to be there in an honorable and send his guys off the right way, so to speak. I just don't feel like LeBron should have to do much if he plays in the 2028 Olympics, like he should just be able to enjoy himself, be on the team.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Jalen Duren's contract situation with the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Duren and the Pistons have not worked out a deal.
quotes.quote: Jalen Duren and the Pistons have not worked out a deal. Best outcome is max if he gets the max from the Pistons, because if he don't get that max, I ain't going to lie, the question marks that are going to surround him will haunt him.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the importance of a max deal for Jalen Duren
quotes.excerpt: He has to be on a max deal to have that leverage.
quotes.quote: He has to be on a max deal to have that leverage. Period, like he would lose some of his value. He has to be on a max deal to have that leverage.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Jalen Duren's need for offensive development
quotes.excerpt: All he needs is like some offensive go-to to a pro hop, to a jump hook.
quotes.quote: All he needs is like some offensive go-to to a pro hop, to a jump hook, something that's quick though. It just seemed like he was very indecisive, and like the speed of the playoffs kind of jumped on him.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Jalen Duren's need for a go-to move
quotes.excerpt: It could be a quick jab move, he could get into a jab step, jab step, rip move.
quotes.quote: It could be a quick jab move, he could get into a jab step, jab step, rip move, jab step, spin like Melo used to do. However you do it, it just got to be quick and something that it's like we know you're getting to it. Either you're doing this or you're doing this, but it depends on dude's footwork. It just has to be something that is no guarding it, because he's so big if he hits this shoulder, hits your other shoulder, he's by you.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on James Harden's need for a fadeaway jumper
quotes.excerpt: If James Harden realized that in the playoffs he has to shoot a fadeaway jumper.
quotes.quote: If James Harden realized that in the playoffs he has to shoot a fadeaway jumper, the moment he realizes that, he's going to go to the championship again. Like, nigga, shoot a fucking pull-up. You watch all your favorite players do it.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Jalen Duren's offensive technique
quotes.excerpt: Get that shoulder to that outside shoulder, learn to serve the pizza on the dunk.
quotes.quote: Get that shoulder to that outside shoulder, learn to serve the pizza on the dunk, and then if you can, get you that, that Melo where I take this step out here, now he brings his right shoulder instead of letting my left shoulder meet his left shoulder, he bring his right shoulder over to meet my left shoulder and I Melo immediately spin, violent dunk. That's all you need, two moves, that's it.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert

quotes.quote: KG used to do it all the time, take that bitch, hook. Soon as he do this, he just seeing where your shoulder's going to go. You take a step back, I might just pop your stupid ass.

quotes.quote: Demar DeRozan is always going to be quality, he counts by two, he doesn't count by three, but in the playoff time you really could use a guy like Demar DeRozan as been through the ups and downs of the playoffs.

quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Bruce Brown's role
quotes.excerpt: Bruce Brown, always a part of winning basketball, he's one of those guys that are always in the hat.
quotes.quote: Bruce Brown, always a part of winning basketball, he's one of those guys that are always in the hat. He's a very, you know, glue piece.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert's advice to NBA rookies
quotes.excerpt: Do not get so wrapped up in their own story.
quotes.quote: Do not get so wrapped up in their own story. A lot of these guys are going to be joining organizations that are in a mode right now where they're trying to win, so they're trying to develop a player that can fit as a piece to the puzzle. I think that coming out of college, your immediate reaction is to leave an impression on the league and to think about yourself, and I think that thinking about winning might be thinking about yourself in an indirect way.
